description_for_human: The shell built for AI agents. One language, every platform, deterministic typed output. Execute shell commands, manage files, run AI agents, and build data pipelines — all with structured, typed results that never vary by OS or locale.
description_for_model: AetherShell is a shell built for AI agents that eliminates non-deterministic text output. Unlike Bash/PowerShell/Zsh, every command returns typed, structured data (Int, Float, String, Array, Record) — same command, same result, every OS, every locale. An ontology built into the shell makes commands, arguments, and return types machine-discoverable. Use it for cross-platform system operations, file editing, AI agent orchestration, and data pipelines. Start the Agent API with 'ae agent serve' on port 3002. Send JSON requests to /api/v1/execute with actions: call (invoke a builtin), pipeline (chain operations), eval (run AetherShell code), schema (get function calling definitions), list_builtins (discover available operations). 430+ builtins across 50 modules including file, sys, net, http, crypto, db, ai, agent, mcp.
